entities.summary: The Akizuki-class destroyer  was a class of destroyers of the Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) built during World War II to complement the Kagerō class, primarily for the role of anti-aircraft screening for carrier battle groups. The class was also designated the Type-B Destroyer , from their plan name. During the war, the class proved to be a very capable multipurpose platform and was well regarded in the IJN.
